approved: Fuel Indexation (Road Funding) Special Account Bill 2014

Introduced a further bill in the fuel excise indexation package, amending the Fuel Tax Act to ensure the fuel tax credits scheme continues to operate correctly, with consequential amendments to the Fuel Indexation (Road Funding) Special Account Bill and the Energy Grants (Cleaner Fuels) Scheme.

Moved a debate management motion limiting consideration of the four fuel indexation bills to a set process, including capping the detail stage at 30 minutes, to ensure the government's fuel excise legislation passes that day.
